name: USB Wi-Fi for wireless CarPlay (RTL8811AU)
description: Runs the hotspot for wireless CarPlay on a TP-Link Archer T2U Nano or Nano AC600 (USB ID 2357:011e) in the USB port, for a head unit with no working built-in Wi-Fi. Replaces the Broadcom Wi-Fi driver with a Realtek one built for the unit's kernel; removing the mod restores it. Only for the cars listed, and not for a unit whose Wi-Fi chip HMG-API has seen. Turn ADB over USB off before plugging in the adapter, and pull the adapter before turning it back on.
